purpose: Sanity checks the external lab runs BEFORE formal validation, to verify their setup matches ours.

checks.name: Simulator reproducibility
checks.method: Run `python 05_simulator.py --all-scenarios` on lab's machine. Compare to p01_simulator_results_ALLSCENARIOS.json.
checks.pass_criterion: All metrics within ±5% of pre-registered values. Specifically: P_ICP peaks within ±1 mmHg, isolation counts within ±1, survival verdict matches.
checks.on_fail: Investigate Python version, random seed handling. Do not proceed with bench validation until simulator reproduces.

checks.name: Bench pump calibration
checks.method: Measure pump output volume over 1 hour. Compare to setpoint (0.30 mL/min).
checks.pass_criterion: Measured flow within ±5% of setpoint (0.285 - 0.315 mL/min).
checks.on_fail: Recalibrate pump. CSF production rate is the most critical parameter — cannot proceed without accurate flow.

checks.name: Pressure sensor calibration
checks.method: Apply known hydrostatic pressure (water column of known height). Compare to sensor reading.
checks.pass_criterion: Sensor reading within ±0.5 mmHg of known pressure across range 0-30 mmHg.

checks.name: Flow sensor calibration
checks.method: Pump known flow rate through sensor. Compare to sensor reading.
checks.pass_criterion: Sensor reading within ±0.05 mL/min of known flow across range 0-0.5 mL/min.

checks.name: Valve response time
checks.method: Command valve from 0% to 100%. Measure time to reach 95% of commanded opening.

checks.name: Valve linearity
checks.method: Command valve to 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%. Measure effective conductance at each.
checks.on_fail: Recalibrate valve command mapping. If non-linear, fit a calibration curve.

checks.name: Leak test
checks.method: Pressurize system to 20 mmHg with all valves closed. Monitor for 1 hour.
checks.on_fail: Locate and fix leak. Cannot proceed with validation if system leaks.

checks.name: Temperature stability
checks.method: Monitor water bath temperature over 24 hours.

checks.name: Data acquisition sync
checks.method: Generate known signal (1 Hz sine wave) on all sensor channels. Verify timestamps align.
checks.pass_criterion: All channels sample within ±10 ms of each other.

checks.name: Software environment snapshot
checks.method: Record Python version, OS, library versions. Compare to package owner's environment.
checks.pass_criterion: Python 3.8+. No external library dependencies. Should run anywhere.
checks.on_fail: Document environment differences. May or may not affect results.

all_checks_must_pass: Formal validation cannot begin until RC-01 through RC-10 all pass. Any failure must be documented and resolved before proceeding.
check_log_required: Lab must record date, technician, pass/fail status, and any deviations for each check. Log is part of validation package.
